decision: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Thirty-four lines of attack were run and none produced a defect. Every load-bearing claim was re-derived from primary bytes rather than read back from the draft: both Stage A digests and both verdicts against the reviews' own count fields; all seven Claude identifiers in order with their sorted member sets and the observations / observationsNotFindings shape on both reviews; the Codex empty-list negatives; HEAD, the D-300 adoption commit, the 285-heading tail, and the live COORD and file-08 digests; the DR-G21 OPEN token and the condition 2 and condition 4 figures at file 08 lines 357, 415 and 417; the fixture as 4 bytes 01 00 00 00 with no body and a digest equal to recordedInputs; the absence of a platform subdirectory at v11 against the four that fixtures/g21.v2/ and fixtures/g21.v8/ really carry; the ordered-equal G10 and G23 platform arrays and the missing platforms key on G21 occupancy v4; D-293 item 8's delegated set, which names G21, and its own phrase 'same-id ROW twin'; the twin search across every OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING carrier, which finds v13 alone and finds doctor-actor leftover-join.v12 expressly disclaiming it; the v9 dual REJECT and its landing at v10; the Codex v10 SHOULD-FIX proved unlabeled by has(id) false and proved to be on exactly two basedOn roles by its where list; and the branch endpoints against the D-236 and D-272 exclusions. Three candidate defects survived first contact -- the continuity verb on a directory this artifact created, the gate-unqualified 'occupancy v4' beside two other gates' occupancies, and the unqualified 'far-over' in the heading and Decision limb -- and each was pursued to source. Each failed to reach SHOULD-FIX on measured evidence: the first because every operative element is byte-true and the duplication is already carried as CLAUDE-G21FXV11-O-1; the second because no misreading survives the bytes and the frozen subject uses the same bare token under a Stage A bareVersionTokenAudit that accepted it; the third because the Subject names the case id carrying the qualifier, says 'one remaining CC-5 prefix injection' in the singular against a one-member catalog, and states 'because CC-5 is not fully authored'. All four are recorded as advisories.
